gloss: to be buried; to be hidden; to be lost among

definitions.gloss: to be buried; to be covered; to be snowed under
definitions.explanation: To be physically buried or covered by something piled on top — snow, sand, rubble, objects, etc.

definitions.gloss: to be hidden; to be lost among; to go unnoticed
definitions.explanation: To be obscured or overlooked among many other things, or to live in obscurity without recognition.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}が{雪|ゆき}に{埋|うず}もれた。
examples.english: The house was buried in snow.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}が{書類|しょるい}に{埋|うず}もれている。
examples.english: The desk is buried under documents.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{瓦礫|がれき}に{埋|うず}もれた{人|ひと}が{救出|きゅうしゅつ}された。
examples.english: People buried under rubble from the earthquake were rescued.

examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}が{埋|うず}もれてしまう。
{大量|たいりょう}の{情報|じょうほう}の{中|なか}に{埋|うず}もれてしまった。
examples.english: It got lost among the massive amount of information.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}に{埋|うず}もれた{偉人|いじん}たちの{物語|ものがたり}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす。
examples.english: Unearthing the stories of great people lost to history.

notes:
Intransitive ichidan verb. Takes the particle に to indicate what something is buried in or under. Very common both literally (buried in snow, rubble) and figuratively (talent going unnoticed, information being lost).

TRANSITIVITY:
- {埋|うず}もれる (intransitive): to be buried, to be hidden
- {埋|う}める (transitive): to bury, to fill in

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雪|ゆき}に{埋|うず}もれる: to be buried in snow
- {書類|しょるい}に{埋|うず}もれる: to be buried under paperwork
- {才能|さいのう}が{埋|うず}もれる: for talent to go unrecognized
- {歴史|れきし}に{埋|うず}もれる: to be lost to history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {埋|う}まる: to be buried — similar meaning, but {埋|うず}もれる emphasizes being completely covered or hidden
- {隠|かく}れる: to hide — active hiding; {埋|うず}もれる implies passive concealment
